response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(GOT) as overall_got FROM Laboratory), patient_avgs AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) as avg_got, AVG(RBC) as avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID) SELECT pa.ID, pa.avg_got, pa.avg_rbc, pa.avg_got - oa.overall_got as got_difference FROM patient_avgs pa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE oa.overall_got IS NOT NULL ORDER BY got_difference IS NULL, got_difference DESC LIMIT 10;
